High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Leia Seeker]] (A New Hope Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>A New Hope/A New Hope Dark/Leia Seeker.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeYkZtbU81R0hXRDQ/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Leia Seeker.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,528 bytes, SHA-256 <code>ee7783fe28409af16492b391578a527e5649b4fbf59ef656d26e89446439dc84</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This actual physical original scan supplies [[Leia Seeker]]’s primary printed face and matching high-resolution source. The separate [[:File:ANH-D-leiaseeker-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher archival digital image]] uses the replacement wording documented in the 1998 Glossary at [[Leia Seeker (Errata)]]. Both source assets and their original provenance are retained.

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
